name: Ice VII
notes: Average hydrogen-disordered Pn-3m single-site model from Gajda et al., IUCrJ 12, 288-294 (2025), doi:10.1107/S2052252525002581: O at 2a and half-occupied H at 8e. The paper cautions that the local disorder is more complex than this average model; it is used here for powder X-ray lines. The lattice is set to the default 300 K PVT-fit V0.

eos_records.label: Bezacier et al. (2014), PVT BM2
eos_records.notes: Joint PVT fit for pure H2O ice VII. Published molar V0=12.49(1) cm^3/mol is converted to the Z=2 unit cell. The second-order Birch-Murnaghan form fixes K0'=4; dK/dT was fixed to zero because no temperature dependence was detectable. The numeric domains give the extrema of the ice-VII measurements tabulated in the paper.

eos_records.label: Frank et al. (2004), 300 K BM3
eos_records.notes: Independent 300 K compression fit. Published molar V0=12.4(1) cm^3/mol is converted to the Z=2 cubic cell. The fit used all three BM3 variables simultaneously; the numeric pressure domain is the range of the authors' 300 K compression data.
